scope: Bounded exact-source contracts; correlated same-team review is not independent validation. No new proof acceptance, native jobs, code, docs, shared registry or remote changes.

gates.subject: Combinatorics/DirectedGraph, using Logic/FiniteSequences
gates.input: Finite rows : List (Key × PathUnfolding.Occurrence root), one fixed root/quiver. Equality compares complete EdgeTrace.TotalEdge tags: explicit DecidableEq or classical noncomputable mathematical choice, with no executable claim.
gates.construction: D=(rows.flatMap (fun row => List.inits (OccurrencePrefix.trace row.2))).dedup. Existing IndexedDictionary.Packed stores complete traces in D and original ordered references (key,D.idxOf(trace occurrence)).
obligations: Prove d∈D iff some input trace extends d; prefix closure; ValidFrom root for every d; actual EdgeTrace.decode reconstruction with trace exactly d.

Consume existing unpack_map_indices to recover original keys, complete traces, order and multiplicity exactly. Recovering occurrences must use actual encode/decode equivalence and trace injectivity, not a new codec axiom.
Prove D.length ≤ sum over rows of (trace.length+1).
controls: Bool parallel one-edge histories give distinct tagged children sharing only[] despite equal endpoints.
Repeated rows retain separate ordered references even if their payload is shared.
gates.limits: Finite shared prefix identity inventory only. GCA, parent-pointer/edge-only reconstruction, incremental slot stability, byte/optimal compression and Python/JSON refinement remain separate. Endpoints never replace complete tags; no permission/proof authority.

gates.subject: Analysis/MellinTransform
gates.object: G(Z,j,y)=A(y)*P((2:ℝ)^j*y/Z)/(Real.sqrt y:ℂ), j:ℕ, exact normalized P and current annulus A. Use their Analysis modules without a NumberTheory detector dependency.
obligations: Prove zero for y≤1/2 and y≥2, and compact support in[1/2,2], for arbitrary Z.
For Z>0 prove ContDiff ℝ ∞ G via the positive-argument real-log formula/nonzero square root when y>0, and a locally zero expression otherwise. Preserve the source premise without asserting necessity.
For y>0 prove(sqrt y:ℂ)*G(Z,j,y)=A(y)*P(2^j*y/Z), independently of Z.
Package this exact G as a SchwartzMap using existing HasCompactSupport.toSchwartzMap; the constructor is reuse.
controls: At j0,Z1,y3/4 prove A>0,P≠0,sqrt(3/4)≠1: omitting1/sqrt changes the actual weighted identity. y1 cannot detect this error.
Do not claim Z0 is nonsmooth: totalized P0 may leave a smooth cutoff/sqrt expression.
Prove the concrete wrong-window counterexample before the sole intended negative consumer omits its factor.
gates.limits: GaussianLow.physicalSpectralRow_eq_dyadic_inverse16 still needs actual characters, maximal-prime set, fixed bad primes, support, calibration, ideal row/norm suppliers. Neither this window nor coefficient-one reassembly admits that theorem. Mellin convergence/vertical integrability/inversion require actual further suppliers, no assumed wrapper or RH continuation.
